page.layout: One printed page (right of the scan). Running head top centre, page number top right. Running text in paragraphs. Below it, a bracketed outline (diagram) with a label beside the brace and boxes at several depths. Gathering signature at the foot. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: exsequenda, & Filij enarrantis illa iudicia, quæ aliàs sigillorum instar clausa essent, nisi ille aperiret: & hæc quidem cap. 4. 5. & 6. iii. in apertionem sigillorum signatis prius electis. cap. 7. 8. 9. 10. II. I V à cap. 12. ad finem continet novas & insignes visiones, quarum aliæ confirmant præcedentia: aliæ proprie ad regnum Antichristi pertinent & ad vltima tempora: aliæ duobus vltimis capitibus proponunt nobis hypotypôsin iucundissimam triumphi Christi & eius Ecclesiæ triumphantis in cœlis.

p.i: Verum nos in capitum coherentia & dispositione indi-canda, lineamenta, à clariss. Theologo, D. Frn: Iunio dudta[?], potissimum sequemur.

main_text.p: Partes itaque Apocalypseos sunt tres: eorumque duæ sunt & dicuntur ἀκρωτήρια[?] i. extremita-tes, partes accessoriæ, minusque principales. Principa-lis pars appellatur πραγματεία[?] seu Tractatio essentialis.
main_text.head: De Prima Parte,
main_text.p: Quæ est primum ἀκρωτήριον, vsitatè proœ-mium seu exordium vocitata i. Capite primo, à v. 1. vsque ad v. penultimum.
main_text.l: Huius ἀ[illegible, ~6 letters] membra duo sunt
Generalis, complectitur genus, autorem, finem, materiâ, instrumen-ta, modumque communicationis (v. 1.) fidem religiosissimam Apo-stoli ut testis publici, (v. 2.) usum communicationis illius:(v. 3.)
Particularis, quâ salutantur certæ Ecclesiæ Catholicam Ecclesiam figurantes: ad v. 8. usque.
Narratio præuia ad autoritatem & vocationem Apostoli Iohannis, in singulari hac revelatione exponendam, fidemque faciendâ huic Prophetiæ: usque ad v. penult. capitis I.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Greek ἀκρωτήρια, πραγματεία and the Greek of the diagram label are doubtful and marked [?] or [illegible]. "dudta" is doubtful. The Roman numeral "I V" in the cap. 7–12 sentence is printed with a space and is copied as printed. The gathering mark at the foot reads "Y. iiij."
